_source: tavya.io, 993 task trees and 4,040 metered turns, 2026-08-09..2026-10-27 (task_mvpsonuk2587aa902d). Aggregates only. Dollar figures are API-equivalent; metering before that task's fix missed sub-agents and turns ended by a limit, so tree sizes, burn rate and login capacities are scaled up by assumption (see wiki planned/quota-scheduling).
_treeMeanUsd: metered mean $17.85 (median $4.5, p99 $346) x2 for unmetered sub-agents and failed turns
_treeSigma: log-normal fit of metered tree cost
_turn: turn.prompt to result: median 1.9 min, p90 16.8, p99 48.5 (n=5,698)
_burn: median $0.40/min per running turn (task #19: $10 in 26 min, main loop only)
_coldStart: re-writing a cold prompt cache (~0.3M tokens at $5/M) when a tree resumes after > 1 h
_interrupt: work lost when a window runs out mid-turn
_parallel: share of trees with sub-tasks running at once; up to 10 at a time (tasks per tree p99 7, max 26)
_dispersion: negative-binomial k of roots per day: mean 12.7, variance 82
_capacity: Claude Max 20x: one 5 h window spent by 10 Opus agents in 16-34 min; that window was 17% of the week
_mix: priority is unset on 96% of tasks (unset = medium); the rest is an assumption
